levels.surface: محمّد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطّاب

notes: Rule 11: al-Faqih's statement of his route («فقد رويته») to a book («ما كان فيه عن أبي الورد») with no saying: the route is written as the text gives it, but the case is for a ruling
«أبي» is al-Saduq's father, given only as a relation; «رحمه اللّه» is a blessing, left out
